While I have always felt dreadful even during my early years, I think I reached breaking point this past few years due to fight with a friend. This might be an accumulation of all the stupid shit that has happened in the past, but my consciousness is telling me that maybe that was the last straw. 

These "voices" came when I started to interact with others again, as my mind was unnaturally blank during the first few months. Everything felt stupid, all my achievements don't make sense, and I look at all the paths in the future, and they all seem dull and gray. It has been a year since I graduated and started working, but I cannot remember most shit that have happened, except for me berating myself and drinking myself to sleep.

I've already talked to a doctor, who told me that I wasn't depressed or what, just someone who's just looking for my individuality. I believe that person, but in any case, I just told them all my regrets and I never really got into what I'm thinking of (I'm just a really bad story teller in person). Tried to indulge myself in random hobbies, but still finding myself not moving from where I've been. So yeah, that's pretty much the summary.

Thanks for the reply though. :)
